exposure: socio-demographic profile (age, residence, education, socio-economic status, family jointness, occupation)
history of obstetric complication (prolonged labor, post-partum hemorrhage)
cohort: The study included fifty-one patients diagnosed with post-partum psychosis admitted to the psychiatry ward of A.B.V. Medical College Vidisha.
finding: The study found that patients with post-partum psychosis commonly presented with specific socio-demographic characteristics (young, rural, lower SES, primipara), obstetric complications, menstrual irregularities, and medical comorbidities like anemia and postpartum infection.
mod_finding: The study found that 41.17% of the subjects with post-partum psychosis had experienced a cesarean delivery.
